aubergine.$description: Aubergine — Primary text, icon strokes, hairline borders, and the dark-section fill — the structural ink of the system; every functional border carries this tint rather than neutral gray

fuchsia-signal.$description: Fuchsia Signal — Primary action fill (Sign up CTA, active states) — the only hot chromatic in the system, reserved exclusively for the conversion moment

heather.$description: Heather — Pink accent for outlined action borders, linked labels, and lightweight interactive emphasis.

glowstick.$description: Glowstick — Hero gradient terminal color and decorative accent — a single warm yellow used only for celebration moments and the sunset gradient

plum-tinted.$description: Plum Tinted — Mauve-tinted light border, the default hairline — always carries a hint of the brand purple rather than being pure gray

ink.$description: Ink — Icon strokes and link text where the brand purple is too saturated; the near-neutral companion to Aubergine

smoke.$description: Smoke — Soft border and muted heading accent — a lighter companion to Plum Tinted for secondary dividers

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Body text fallback and image-level deep fills

frost.$description: Frost — Input border, form field resting state

forest.$description: Forest — Success badge text and inline success state — a true forest green for confirmations and positive feedback

mint.$description: Mint — Green outline accent for tags, dividers, and focused UI edges. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

honeydew.$description: Honeydew — Success badge background — the soft mint wash behind positive status pills

strawberry.$description: Strawberry — Red outline accent for tags, dividers, and focused UI edges. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

mango.$description: Mango — Green outline accent for tags, dividers, and focused UI edges. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

canvas.$description: Canvas — Page background, card surface, button text on dark fills

hero-glow.$description: Hero Glow — Terminal stop of the hero gradient — a soft rose that opens the sunset wash

inter-var.$description: Workhorse UI and body font — the single axis variable cuts tracking at every size (-0.02em at 10px through -0.004em at 36px), so body text and headings share one family with no jarring weight jumps.

kaio.$description: Display headlines — bold, ultra-condensed sans with strong character, used at 56-80px for hero statements. The choice of a single bold weight with tight tracking is anti-convention; most SaaS sites pair weight 300 whispers with 700 shouts. Kaio commits fully to one volume.

jetbrains-mono.$description: Section eyebrows and technical labels (e.g. 'STRIPE VERIFIED PARTNER', 'ALL-IN-ONE MEMBERSHIP STACK') — the wide tracking (0.04-0.10em) turns mono into a humanist label voice, not code.

permanent-marker.$description: Handwritten annotations layered over the hero gradient ('SEE WHAT OUR CUSTOMERS ARE BUILDING', 'HOOK IN THE FIRST 90 MINUTES') — these are not body text, they are a personality layer; use sparingly to mark sections, not to carry meaning.

phosphor.$description: Icon system — single weight, single color (Aubergine #240029), 1px-equivalent stroke, used inline with body copy and as standalone glyphs.

font-awesome-6-brands.$description: Third-party brand glyphs (integration logos, social icons) — kept distinct from Phosphor so the system can mix its own line icons with customer brand marks without visual collision.

phosphor-bold.$description: Phosphor-Bold — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

phosphor-fill.$description: Phosphor-Fill — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
